name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot is a CRM platform with a developer platform, OAuth apps, service keys and remote MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow for apps (access and refresh tokens); service keys, formerly private-app-style tokens, sent as Bearer tokens for account-level calls.
gate_detail: Credentials are created inside a HubSpot account under Development (apps, service keys). Sources do not state which plan tier or free signup is needed; installing OAuth apps may require a Super Admin.
api_scope: CRM APIs such as contacts accessed at api.hubapi.com, with scope-based permissions; also CMS and other API areas listed in navigation, plus a developer CLI.
mcp_notes: HubSpot offers a remote MCP server for CRM access and a local CLI-based developer MCP server.
blocker_detail: Requires a HubSpot account; installs can need a Super Admin, and some scopes depend on account subscription tier. Free-signup access path not stated.

evidence.quote: sending a URL-form encoded POST request to https://api.hubapi.com/oauth/v3/token
You can then include your service key as a Bearer token in your preferred API client or programming language.
